prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1333; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was turning left at a green light when a pickup truck coming the other way struck the front driver's side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle slightly and I felt my right shoulder jerk hard against the seatbelt. I stopped at the scene, spoke with the other driver and the responding officer, and I have described what happened the same way every time since then, both to the adjuster and to the medical staff who examined me. I am the named driver on this policy and was operating the vehicle with the owner's permission. I have been treated for a shoulder injury and am still limited in lifting and reaching with my right arm. I am submitting this account so the claim can be reviewed, and I can provide any further details the insurer requires.
